scope: Bare singular Bokmål nouns. Select any permitted grammatical gender: masculine (en), feminine (ei), or neuter (et). Feminine nouns also permit masculine inflection in Bokmål; additional dictionary-attested alternatives are accepted. Grammatical gender does not describe the person or object.
